title: test(example-todo): boot the loop-body kernel once per file under a measured budget
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiWpz18m9kVbxeipdp31C27T)_

Fixes #31298

This is also the fix for the queue-flake anchor #31294 (same file, same case); the anchor can be closed with this PR.

Clause-②: no — test-only; no accept set, schema or export changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`examples/app-todo/test/loop-body-iteration.test.ts` 不再每条用例各启动一个完整的 todo kernel,改为整个文件在 `beforeAll` 里启动一次(带 30 秒实测预算),每条用例前清空 `todo_task` 行和捕获的通知。五条用例的断言一字未改。只改这一个测试文件。
- 为什么改:启动约占每条用例耗时的 80%。在负载高的 Test Core 分片上,第一条用例(启动 + 一次执行)三次被 vitest 默认 5 秒截断(5011 / 5015 / 5033 ms),把与它无关的 PR 踢出合并队列(#31249、#31258),#31279 也因此红了两次。
- #31298 的假设已实测排除:去掉 #31230 加的三个源码别名,本文件耗时不变(这个文件的导入链根本不经过那三个包),所以 `vitest.config.ts` 不改。
- 风险与回滚:只改测试文件,不发布(skip-changeset)。隔离已验证:4 种乱序和 5 条单跑都绿;去掉每例前的清空则 5 条里 4 条红。回滚即 revert。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run test/loop-body-iteration.test.ts`,预期 5/5 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `examples/app-todo/test/loop-body-iteration.test.ts` only.
  - `bootTodoKernel()` runs once per file in `beforeAll`, under an explicit 30 000 ms budget (`BOOT_BUDGET_MS`) with the measurement written beside it. It used to run inside each of the five cases, under vitest's 5 s per-test default.
  - `beforeEach` gives each case the state a fresh boot leaves: every `todo_task` row is deleted through the driver (so no hook or flow observes the reset), and the captured `messaging.emit()` list is emptied.
  - CONTROL removes the fixture flow it registers (`unregisterFlow`) in a `finally`, so no case leaves a registration behind.
  - `afterAll` disconnects the one driver. This replaces the per-case `afterEach` driver list.
  - Every assertion is unchanged. The doc block says why the suite shares one kernel and how each case still gets a clean state.

## Why

The three failing Test Core jobs all cut off the same case, the file's first:

| job | ESCALATION | EVERY | other 3 | package Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128565270519 (#31279) | 5011 ms, timed out | 1356 ms | 344–502 ms | 50.13 s |
| 128519296820 (queue 42410962891, #31249) | 5033 ms, timed out | 4620 ms | 563–746 ms | 78.25 s |
| 128555004931 (queue 42422774934, #31258) | 5015 ms, timed out | 1691 ms | 416–508 ms | 53.55 s |

Each log shows the case past kernel bootstrap and object registration when the timeout hit. `afterEach` then closed the driver under it and printed `Acquire connection error: Error: aborted` three times. That is slowness, not an assertion failure.

Locally, idle, a case took 90–330 ms, and boot was about 80% of it. Boot phases measured inside the first case: `kernel.use` 3 ms, `bootstrap` 31–42 ms, sqlite-wasm `connect` 35 ms, `syncSchemas` 52–82 ms, Default Organization 45–87 ms, registering the flows 32–44 ms. The `execute` itself took 22–25 ms. So each case put a whole kernel boot under the 5 s per-test line, and on a shard running about 20x slower than an idle box (one warm case took 4620 ms), the first one crossed it.

### #31298's hypothesis, measured: the #31230 aliases are not the cost

#31298 asked for cold and warm timings with and without the package-wide source aliases in `examples/app-todo/vitest.config.ts` (`@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/mcp`). Measured on this container (4 cores), whole example suite, test file from `main` `7c523aa1`. "Cold" means `node_modules/.vite` removed first. "Load" means 8 CPU-bound processes running beside the suite. The numbers are the five case times of this file, in ms:

| variant | cold | warm | load (two runs) | suite wall idle / load |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: `main` (aliases on) | 296,112,224,190,189 | 306,89,219,169,162 / 300,123,242,171,162 | 880,332,379,375,272 / 608,234,345,272,238 | 15.4 s / 37.2–37.5 s |
| B: aliases removed | 507,106,257,206,183 | 338,124,234,178,171 / 268,106,225,173,157 | 831,243,429,359,312 / 691,343,466,340,277 | 15.0–15.4 s / 34.7–37.9 s |
| C: aliases on, `mcp-actions.test.ts` excluded | 266,77,203,166,165 | 283,118,216,186,173 | 852,285,384,332,308 / 813,376,425,379,264 | 9.7 s / 22.7–22.9 s |

A and B are the same within noise. That fits the import graph: none of the `dist/` of `core`, `objectql`, `driver-sql`, `driver-sqlite-wasm` or `service-automation`, which are all this file imports from the platform, imports any of the three aliased packages (0 files). Narrowing the aliases would not change this file. So `vitest.config.ts` is not touched.

What #31230 did change is the package's load. Its `mcp-actions.test.ts` joined the suite and adds about 6 s of idle wall and about 15 s under load (A against C), running in parallel with this file on the same shard. That makes the shard busier. It does not explain the cliff by itself: this file's own case times are the same in A and C.

## Tests

After the fix, on this container, JSON reporter, case times in ms:

- Idle, whole suite: 48, 34, 29, 11, 18. Under 8 CPU hogs: 132, 97, 56, 29, 36. Before the fix the same runs gave 296–880 for the first case.
- File alone, idle: `tests 273–275ms` for the file, boot included. It was `tests 850–874ms` before.
- Isolation: `--sequence.shuffle` with seeds 1, 7, 42 and 1234: 5/5 passed in each order (for example CONTROL, CONTAINMENT, ESCALATION, EVERY, REMINDER). Each case alone (`-t ESCALATION`, `-t EVERY`, `-t CONTAINMENT`, `-t REMINDER`, `-t CONTROL`): 1 passed, 4 skipped, each time.
- Reverse check: with the `beforeEach` reset removed, 4 of 5 cases fail. So the reset is what keeps the shared kernel's cases independent, and it works.
- Sibling files that also boot a kernel: in the same three failing jobs their slowest single case was 2060 ms (task-recurrence `daily`), then 2019 ms and 1888 ms, and task-completion GATES 1763 ms. Locally idle they take 700–1118 ms. None is at the 5 s line, so they are not changed here (see Acceptance notes).

- The whole example suite, 5 runs in a row on `877170f8`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run`, each exit 0 with `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 249 passed (249)`.

## Acceptance notes

- The boot budget is per-file (`beforeAll`, 30 s), not per case. Each case now runs no boot and stays under 150 ms locally even under load, far inside the 5 s default, so the cases keep vitest's default.
- Sibling files in `examples/app-todo/test` that boot a kernel per case: `task-recurrence.test.ts` (4 end-to-end cases, slowest 2060 ms in CI), `task-completion-trigger.test.ts` (slowest 1763 ms), `derived-flag-removal.test.ts` (slowest 1079 ms). Not at the cliff in any of the three failing jobs, so not touched. If one of them is ever cut off, the same one-kernel-per-file shape applies.
- `mcp-actions.test.ts` (from #31230) adds about 6 s of idle suite wall to this package (15.4 s against 9.7 s without it). Its cost is the same with and without the aliases. Not a defect; noted as the package's load.

## Verification

All on `877170f8` (this branch with `origin/main` merged in, no rebase):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 37 commands. Every one ran with exit 0. Before the run, `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --concurrency=2` built every package, because `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads built output and exited 3 (prerequisite not met) without it. `--ran`: "37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo typecheck`: exit 0. The program includes `test/loop-body-iteration.test.ts`, counted with `--listFiles`.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project), because this diff does not touch it. Test Core runs it on this PR.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Test-only in a private example package; nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
